request.event_title: Regional conflict escalation affecting manufacturing continuity
request.event_description: Conflict escalation may disrupt logistics, energy costs, supplier continuity, payment routes, and executive-level trade-off decisions.

selected_candidates.title: Iran supplier disruption due to conflict escalation
selected_candidates.description: FUJIFILM has a high-criticality supplier located in Iran with no alternative source and only 8–30 days of inventory. Escalation of regional conflict directly threatens the continuity of supply from this supplier, with no immediate fallback available.
selected_candidates.rationale: Direct scope match: high-criticality Iran supplier with no alternative and limited inventory buffer. Conflict escalation in Iran creates immediate supply continuity risk for Executive Management overseeing manufacturing operations.

selected_candidates.title: Contractual force majeure and sanctions clause activation across multi-jurisdiction portfolio
selected_candidates.description: FUJIFILM holds contracts governed by England, Singapore, Japan, Germany, and New York law, many with both force majeure and sanctions clauses. Conflict escalation in Iran may trigger force majeure events or sanctions-related termination rights across these jurisdictions, requiring coordinated executive response.
selected_candidates.rationale: Scope match: multi-jurisdiction contract portfolio with sanctions and force majeure clauses. Executive Management must evaluate cross-border contractual exposures, termination rights, and renegotiation strategies as conflict impacts logistics, energy costs, and supplier continuity.

selected_candidates.title: Near-term payment exposure to Iran under sanctions risk
selected_candidates.description: A pending material payment of $1M–$5M to Iran is due within 0–7 days. Conflict escalation increases the risk of payment blockage, regulatory enforcement actions, or secondary sanctions exposure on counterparties facilitating the transaction.
selected_candidates.rationale: Direct scope match: near-term material payment to Iran. Conflict escalation heightens sanctions enforcement risk and payment routing disruption, requiring executive-level trade-off decisions on compliance vs. operational continuity.
